message.content: {"caption":"Two-stage workflow for constructing a memory bank and using it to generate memory-guided answers.","description":"A flowchart shows Stage 1 in blue: dialogues pass through information extraction and a memory-bank search to a Memory Manager, which can ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, or NOOP before producing a constructed memory bank. Stage 2 in green: questions lead to memory retrieval, a memory-augmented prompt, and an Answer Agent that uses generation with memory distillation to produce an answer. Dashed arrows connect the constructed memory bank with the retrieval and prompting process.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
